column1: # Ported from com.zorigt.ime.letter.splice.front.* and .behind.* (east-mod/ime), in the field
# order of FrontRuleHolder and BehindRuleHolder. Each Java rule class is one row.
# Front rules see the sequence built so far (lss); behind rules see the shape about to be
# appended (next). Set membership uses LetterShape.equals(), i.e. (latin_key, zcode, location)
# value equality, not identity. Shapes are named letter.field as in shapes.tsv.
#   last_in S...                lss not empty and last(lss) in S
#   last_not_in S...            lss not empty and last(lss) not in S
#   last_at_not_in LOC S...     lss not empty and location(last) == LOC and last(lss) not in S
#   nature_is N                 lss not empty and nature(lss) == N
#   nature_is_not N             lss not empty and nature(lss) != N
#   not RULE                    (front) lss not empty and not RULE(lss)
#   behind_empty                next absent (the splicer never passes absent: always false)
#   behind_not_empty            next present (always true inside the splicer)
#   next_in S...                next present and next in S
#   next_key_in K...            next present and latin_key(next) in K
